notes.title: Magical Greenhouse v0.5 ✧ Release Note
notes.content:
Magical Greenhouse ⭐️
Magical Greenhouse is a cozy simulation game where you manage your own Potion Shop. Buy some magical plants, create potions and sell them to grow your business ! Currently, we're focusing on updating some features and developing new ones ✨🎉


Join the Playtests :


You're interested to test the game for free and to give feedback to help us improve the game ?
You can now join us on Discord and start to playtest the game ! ✨🎉


Release note v0.5 :


→ New Feature, Experimental Crafting (you can now try to discover recipes by experimenting with the craft)
→ New Feature, the Onboarding (a few screen to help new players to understand)
→ Bug Fixes


Release Note Detailed :


🧪 New Feature, Experimental Crafting :

This is the biggest feature we added so far and we're so happy and proud to release it today ! Previously, the only way to craft potions was to buy some recipes, and then to follow them. We wanted the craft to feel more real and crafty, so we added the possibility to attempt experiments !! What it means is that you can use some of your energy to attempt some unknown potions, following some hints given by the partially known list ! Become a real alchemist discovering potion recipes !



🔮 New Feature, the Onboarding :

As many of you suggested it, it wasn't easy to understand right away what to do when you were starting the game, so we added some onboarding guidance that is displayed the first time you land on a new part of the game, and that you can find at any time by clicking on the help button.



🪲 Bug Fixes :

We had a lot of help from the community, special thanks to everyone who tried the previous version and let us known when you found a bug ! It helps a lot especially to polish and make it even more pleasant to play ! With your help, we fixed a bug in the Store (when placing a product on top of another product, thank you Rosie !), we fixed the weird clicking area for the plants in the Greenhouse, and many more :)


What's Next ?
What you can expect for the next versions and roadmap overview :

→ New Feature, the Quests
→ New Contents (potions and quests)
→ Playtest Campaign starts next week !
→ v0.6 + Demo Released on Steam at the end of September ✨🎉



We hope you'll be excited for what coming next, don't hesitate to share your feedbacks ! There will be much more to come in the coming weeks :) Thank you so much for reading, leave a star in the comments ⭐️ if you're one of the survivors who made it this far !!

notes.title: Magical Greenhouse v0.4 ✧ Release Note
notes.content:
Magical Greenhouse ⭐️
Magical Greenhouse is a cozy simulation game where you manage your own Potion Shop. Buy some magical plants, create potions and sell them to grow your business ! Currently, we're focusing on updating some features and developing new ones ✨🎉


Join the Playtests :


You're interested to test the game for free and to give feedback to help us improve the game ?
You can now join us on Discord and start to playtest the game ! ✨🎉


Release note v0.4 :


→ New Feature, Save the Game (each time you go to the next day)
→ New Feature, the Decors (you can now buy Decors for your business !)
→ New Feature, the Boosts (related to Decors, they provide special Boost !)
→ Content updated, the Alembic animation (currently a WIP)


Release Note Detailed :


💾 New Feature, Save the Game :

This is one of the most requested feature so far, the game is now Saved ! Each time players go to the next day, the game is automatically saved and the message "Game Saved" is displayed at the bottom of the screen. In addition, players can also restart the game by choosing "restart" instead of continue when launching the game :) ⚠️ The game is currently under development and the saves will be erased each time we release a new version ⚠️



🔮 New Feature, the Decors :

In the previous version, Decors were a part of the background and players could not interact with them (appart from discovering Secrets). As we wanted to bring some macro progression, we implemented Decors as items players can buy. Decors are not only items for decoration, but they're also really useful (see bellow Boosts).



⚡️ New Feature, the Boosts :

As we implemented Decors players can buy, we also wanted Decors to be useful in term of gameplay. Decors are not only beautiful items, they're also really useful : each time players buy a Decor, it comes with a Boost impacting positively the game for the players. For example, when players buy decors for the Greenhouse, it will help the plants to grow faster or to produce more. When players buy decors for the Store, it will help them make more money ! Some special decors allow players to unlock bonus features, like the Magic Handle, allowing them to change the Greenhouse background.



🧪 Content Updated, Alembic Animation :

As many players complained about the length of the alembic animation, we provided a quick fix which is not "pretty" but is practical : the alembic animation has been speed up x2 so it can go way faster. It's a temporary solution, as we are currently working on the Craft rework and it will also impact the alembic animation.


What's Next ?
What you can expect for the next versions :

→ Rework of the Workshop (Craft Feature), that's a big one !! (we're super excited for this one to arrive)
→ New Contents (potions)
→ Quests



We hope you'll be excited for what coming next, don't hesitate to share your feedbacks ! There will be much more to come in the incoming months :) Thank you so much for reading, leave a star in the comments ⭐️ if you're one of the survivors who made it this far !!
